bundles.title: Authoritative game loop
bundles.central_question: What does an authoritative game loop do?
bundles.summary: An authoritative game loop repeatedly processes player input and updates the server-owned world state.

structured_content.definition: An authoritative game loop is a repeated server simulation that processes player input, updates world state, and sends results to clients.
key_points: The server determines the accepted world state.

bundles.title: Authoritative game loop recall
bundles.central_question: What does an authoritative game loop do?
